exposure: MRI radiomics signatures from the gestational sac
Maximum inlet diameter of the CSD
outcome: Massive hemorrhage during dilatation and curettage (defined as bleeding exceeding 200 ml)
cohort: The study included 109 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent dilatation and curettage (D&C).
finding: A comprehensive nomogram integrating MRI radiomics signatures and clinical variables (serum b-hCG and maximum inlet diameter of the CSD) accurately predicted the risk of massive hemorrhage during D&C in CSP patients.
